thought.text: Found the issue - a module type mismatch. The server uses "type": "module" but some files use CommonJS. Let me check and fix:

reasoning_content:
There's two issues:
1. There's a conflict - the old logs show the server was working before - it was processing NPC events. But there's a module type mismatch

The error is: "exports is not defined in ES module scope". This means the server is configured as ESM module but some files use CommonJS. Let me check the package.json for "type": "module".

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -c '
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json | grep -A2 type")
print("=== Server package.json type ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check what type is set 
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json | head -10")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Remove the type module
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i \"/\\\"module\\\"/d\" /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Removed type: module")

# Restart PM2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart all && sleep 5 && pm2 list")
print("\\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
'
